verdict: M185 is a correct mask-native multiplier-free K8 signed-weight/Acc24 arithmetic island and should replace M183 as the interface-compatible K8 timing point. It does not deliver the proposed area win: at 27129.815772 um2 it is 0.365447% larger than M183 and 12.056271% above the 24210.885723-um2 K4 standalone density break-even. M169 K4 remains the standalone arithmetic density point. The sum of M184+M185 standalone logic areas yields a conditional 1.158777128x K8/K4 schedule-throughput-per-area screen, but that is not flat composition, physical, complete-FC2, system or headline evidence.

matched_m183_comparison.interpretation: Deleting the bank-ID legality and result-mask network reduces ports and cell count, but M185 must gate bank0 for arbitrary masks while M183's legal prefix guarantees slot0 active. The external bank-to-prefix packing crossbar was absent from M183 standalone DC, so its removal is an unmeasured composition-level benefit, not evidence of standalone area reduction.

standalone_k4_comparison.verdict: Keep M169 K4 as the standalone arithmetic density point; M185 K8 is the lower-schedule-latency and interface-compatible point.

sum_of_standalone_blocks_comparison.qualification: Arithmetic sum of two independently synthesized standalone logic modules only. There is no flat composed netlist, weight SRAM response, inter-module routing, accumulator context owner, BN2/residual commit, power or physical timing.

P0.finding: M184 and M185 have compatible fixed-bank mask semantics, but eight-bank address/weight response, response stalls/tags, Acc24 context ownership/writeback, BN2 and residual commit are absent.
P0.required_action: Compose M184, an explicit eight-bank weight-response shell, M185 and bounded accumulator/commit state; run VCS/SVA and flat DC before claiming complete FC2.

P0.finding: Multiplier-free event-times-INT8-weight behavior is checkpoint-specific to frozen ep35 sn2 thresholds exactly equal to one. No PAFT checkpoint-bound sn2 census and valid825 admission is included.
P0.required_action: Hash the released PAFT checkpoint, census all twelve sn2 thresholds, and require exact one or provide a verified folded-weight/quantization bridge or multiplier path plus valid825.

P0.finding: The 97,607,807-cycle and 1.307079853x values come from the M182 exact-payload analytic scheduler, not M185 RTL timing. The 1.158777128x density number sums standalone block areas rather than a flat composition.
P0.required_action: Replay frozen representative or all-120 materialized payload groups through the composed path, define the measured cycle interval, and keep all present ratios non-physical, non-system and non-headline.

P1.finding: M185 is 0.365447% larger than M183 even though it removes 24 bank-ID port bits and 28 source-level pairwise comparisons. The likely offset is the added bank0 data gating required by arbitrary masks; the claimed external packing crossbar was not present in the M183 DC baseline.
P1.required_action: Market the specialization as interface/timing simplification, not area reduction. Quantify any external adapter/crossbar saving only in a flat composed comparison.

P1.finding: M185 exceeds the K4 density break-even by 2918.930049 um2 and provides only 0.892408777x the matched same-clock analytic schedule throughput per arithmetic logic area of M169.
P1.required_action: Retain K4 as the standalone density point; if a middle Pareto point is needed, precommit and evaluate K5/K6/K7 schedule plus matched DC.

P1.finding: The module consumes 6144 weight bits per full issue and assumes eight simultaneous weight-bank responses without address, macros, response stalls or routing cost.
P1.required_action: Implement and cost the banked memory response and backpressure path before energy, FPS, physical speed or complete-FC2 claims.

P1.finding: RTL VCS and mapped DC pass, but no exact-SHA RTL-to-netlist Formality receipt is included.
P1.required_action: Run Formality for M185 and then for the flat M184+weight-response+M185 composition.

P1.finding: The run uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros; TIM-134 models clk_core and net103582 as fanout 1000 despite 2344/2343 loads.
P1.required_action: Add macro-aware constraints, tie/reset handling, CTS/route extraction and SAIF/PTPX before physical timing, power, energy or paper-PPA claims.

P1.finding: The DC receipt labels the analytic ratio as m169_k4_over_m185_k8 even though the cycle counts originate in M179 and M182 scheduler analyses; the arithmetic RTL has no wall-cycle measurement.
P1.required_action: Use M179-K4/M182-K8 schedule lineage and describe all density values as analytic schedule opportunity divided by matched logic-only area.

P2.finding: The canonical TB uses eight selected masks and ordinary random weights around [-64,64]. The review-only miter closes all 255 masks, -128/127, exact signed24 boundaries and isolated faults, but is not part of the sealed regression.
P2.required_action: Promote the review cases into the next canonical exact-SHA VCS regression.

P2.finding: Bound SVA checks handshakes, stall stability and sticky faults, while source_count popcount, result-mask identity and activity-mask equality are mainly scoreboard checks.
P2.required_action: Add direct relational assertions for those identities.

P2.finding: DC emits one signed-to-unsigned part-selection warning at result truncation. Independent numeric tests pass, but the warning should be made intentional.
P2.required_action: Add an explicit signed truncation cast or a line-specific reviewed waiver.

P2.finding: The sealed DC runner requires area > 24210.885723 as well as area < 30000. A surprisingly successful area result would therefore fail to seal, and this lower bound is not declared as an acceptance condition in the contract.
P2.required_action: In the next runner, accept both sides of the break-even and derive an explicit Boolean verdict; disclose any exploratory calibration.

P2.finding: The pre-run VCS/DC contracts intentionally retain false admission fields after successful runs.
P2.required_action: If a unified machine admission is needed, add a non-destructive overlay keyed to both RUN_COMPLETE hashes.

recommended_next_milestone.name: M184_plus_weight_response_plus_M185_flat_composition
recommended_next_milestone.primary_goal: Turn the conditional 1.158777128x sum-of-standalone schedule-throughput/logic-area screen into a measured composed-module result without reviving prefix packing or a global top-k sorter.
recommended_next_milestone.mandatory_claim_wording: 1.307079853x is the M179-K4/M182-bounded-K8 exact-payload analytic schedule ratio. 1.158777128x is a conditional ratio using sums of standalone logic-only areas. Neither is physical, complete-FC2, system or headline speedup.
